verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party prebuilt connector for n8n, Zapier or similar no-code platforms. The Dockerized FastAPI server is only a developer building block, and the n8n Docker setups come from a community-run hub (crawl4ai.dev), not the product. One community post even notes that developers struggle to bridge Crawl4AI with n8n, which points to the gap rather than filling it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the scraping API to no-code automation platforms like n8n or Zapier through a prebuilt connector
